# Zepra Tech

> Zepra Tech is a US-based digital agency building websites, AI assistants, and growth marketing for US small businesses. Founded in 2025. US office in Middletown, Delaware, with an engineering studio in Lahore, Pakistan. Fixed prices from $1,500. Most websites launch in 2 to 3 weeks.

## About Zepra Tech

Zepra Tech is a digital engineering and marketing agency founded in 2025. Founder and CEO: Muhammad Daud Ali Lashari, an entrepreneur and hands-on digital marketer, and a Computer Science undergrad at Lahore Garrison University. Tagline: Where ideas turn into impact.

Covers responsive website and platform development, content management and ecommerce integrations, and performance-focused implementation. Deliverables: a production-ready website, responsive page templates, and launch and handoff support. Technologies: Next.js, React, WordPress, Wix.

Covers AI assistant and chatbot planning, business workflow automation, and integration with existing tools. Deliverables: a configured AI assistant or bot, workflow and integration setup, and testing and deployment support. Technologies: OpenAI, Python, Node.js, APIs.

### Cold Outreach

https://gozepra.tech/cold-outreaching

Precision B2B cold calling, SMS outreach, and high-deliverability email marketing powered by verified lead scraping and enterprise CRM pipelines. Multi-channel cold outreach that books sales calls. Cold calling, SMS, and email to verified US businesses, tracked in Salesforce and RingCentral. Covers B2B cold calling and qualified discovery calls (RingCentral), high-deliverability cold email marketing and drip sequences (Salesforce), targeted SMS outreach and fast intent-driven follow-ups, precision lead scraping and verification (Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha, SignalHire, Scraper.io, Yelp, LinkedIn Sales Navigator), Salesforce CRM pipeline architecture and deal attribution, and strategic market messaging distribution. Deliverables: verified, double-scrubbed B2B lead lists with direct dials and validated emails; high-converting cold email sequences, domain warming and inbox deliverability setup; objection-handling phone scripts, RingCentral dialing workflows and booked sales calls; Salesforce pipeline configuration, lead scoring and automated CRM sync; targeted SMS outreach campaigns with compliance-ready messaging; transparent weekly outreach analytics, response rates and sales conversion reporting.

## Pricing

https://gozepra.tech/pricing

- Launch: from $1,500 one-time. For a small business that needs a sharp website, fast. Custom website, up to 5 pages; mobile-first, tap-to-call; local SEO and Google Maps; contact and quote forms. Launch in 2 to 3 weeks.
- Growth: $3,000 to $8,000 one-time. For a business that wants the website to also answer and book. Everything in Launch, plus an AI assistant trained on your services; booking, CRM, and lead follow-up; review and referral prompts. Launch in 3 to 4 weeks.
- Scale: $8,000 to $18,000 one-time. For a growing business that needs a custom platform. Everything in Growth, plus a custom platform or online store; AI workflows across sales and support; payments and dashboards. Launch in 6 to 8 weeks.
- Enterprise: $18,000+, scoped per project. For multi-location and multi-market businesses. Everything in Scale, plus multi-market and multi-location setup; custom AI systems and data pipelines; dedicated support and SLAs. Timeline agreed in writing.
- Every quote is fixed in writing before work starts.

## Process

https://gozepra.tech/about

1. Discovery: We understand your business model, priorities, audience, and operational needs before proposing solutions.
2. Strategy: We define the digital roadmap, scope, messaging, systems, and priorities required for the engagement to succeed.
3. Design: We shape the user experience, visual language, and content structure to support trust, clarity, and conversion.
4. Development: We build the website, workflows, or automation systems with a focus on performance, maintainability, and polish.
5. Launch: We prepare deployment, testing, and quality assurance so the launch feels stable, professional, and client-ready.
6. Growth / Support: We continue with optimization, support, content, marketing, and improvement cycles after the initial release.

## Frequently asked questions

- How much does a small business website cost? Launch starts at $1,500 for up to 5 pages. Most sites with an AI assistant land in Growth, $3,000 to $8,000. Your quote is fixed in writing.
- How long until my website is live? Most websites launch in 2 to 3 weeks. Sites with an AI assistant and CRM take 3 to 4 weeks. Custom platforms take 6 to 8 weeks.
- Do I own my website, code, and accounts? Yes. You own 100% of the code, the domain, the hosting account, and your data. No lock-in, no monthly fee to keep your own website.
- What is an AI agent, and do I need one? An AI agent answers questions, takes bookings, and collects lead details around the clock, using your own services and prices. It helps if you miss calls or repeat the same answers.
- Do you work outside the United States? Yes. US small businesses come first, and we also work with businesses in Pakistan and worldwide. Our US office is in Middletown, Delaware.
- How do we start? Book a free 15-minute consultation, or call +1 (302) 469-4003. We talk, then send a written quote with a fixed price and a launch date.
- What is included in the Launch package? A custom website of up to 5 pages, mobile-first with tap-to-call, local SEO and Google Maps, and contact and quote forms.
- What happens after my website launches? We stay on call. Launch includes handoff support, and ongoing work covers optimization, support, content, marketing, and improvement cycles.
